title: Integrate Deno runtime in Rust
description:
Add Deno runtime integration to the generated Rust GraphQL resolvers.

Key components:
1. Add `deno_core` and `deno_runtime` dependencies
2. Create a `DenoResolver` struct that:
   - Loads TypeScript modules
   - Executes resolver functions
   - Handles async/Promise resolution
   - Marshals data between Rust and JS

3. Generate async-graphql resolvers that call into Deno:
\`\`\`rust
async fn full_name(&self, ctx: &Context<'_>) -> Result<String> {
    let deno = ctx.data::<DenoResolver>()?;
    deno.call_field_resolver("resolvers/user.ts", "fullName", self, &()).await
}
\`\`\`

Security:
- Apply DenoPermissions from proto options
- Sandbox by default (no network, no fs)
close_reason: Implemented DenoResolver with file-based module loading, tested with 7 passing integration tests

title: Deno-Rust data marshaling
description:
Implement serialization between Rust types and Deno JavaScript.

Requirements:
- Serialize parent objects (User, Post) to JS objects
- Serialize arguments to JS
- Deserialize return values from JS
- Handle async/Promise returns
- Support DataLoader access from JS

Use serde_v8 or similar for efficient marshaling.

Error handling:
- Map JS exceptions to GraphQL errors
- Include stack traces in development mode
